name: Yeganeh Madadi
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science; Robotics Lab Director
department: Computer Science; Robotics Lab / YeRo Lab
fitReason: New-2024 Assistant Professor and active social-robotics lab director. Public research software provides substantive LLM interaction and neural pose-perception pipelines. A current executed learned robot experiment is not fully established, so this is an applied-HRI methods backup rather than a confirmed physical-AI deployment or summer placement.

physicalEvidence.summary: Official lab-opening material verifies a real YeRo humanoid and demonstrations. The lab-linked SAR repository explicitly simulates perception, child responses and robot output; real LLM calls are optional and physical integration remains future work. A separate Robo-TA repository implements embedding/chat-based tutoring, MediaPipe pose detection, raised-hand patrol and Pepper speech/navigation bridges. Static source inspection verifies the pipeline, not that every learned component ran successfully on the robot. The full 2026 HRI benchmark paper was not accessible, so its title is not used to prove execution.

shortVisit.summary: The current lab lists graduate researchers and welcomes university/industry research partners. The PI provides a general inquiry contact, but no distinct outside-master visiting or summer-intern invitation was verified. Local summer researchers and high-school demonstrations do not establish external graduate access.

unknowns: Summer 2027 capacity, duration, funding, remote participation and access to the humanoid remain unknown.

The constrained-LLM storytelling repository describes an experimental prototype. Its simulated perception and synthetic interactions do not establish clinical use or benefit for autistic children; no clinical or safety efficacy is inferred.

Robo-TA was inspected as public source text only. It was not installed, executed, connected to hardware or supplied credentials. Code-level bridges and lab photographs alone do not prove a completed robot-learning evaluation.

App State central guidance requires ISSSO and host approval and at least three months of preparation. Personal financial evidence is allowed, but the appropriate research appointment for an external master’s student is not explicitly settled; a Student Intern route was not verified.

The university gives the support estimate individually and requires GeoBlue for its listed scholar categories. Current premiums, university charges and total 2027 costs are unknown. A six-month category ceiling is not a lab invitation or a required research duration.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
